title: Chargeback Friendly-Fraud Evidence Pack
oneLiner: Small merchants assemble transaction, fulfillment, and conversation proof before friendly-fraud disputes drain margin.
theme: 자산 방어 - small merchants protecting cash from first-party fraud and chargeback leakage.
targetUser: Shopify sellers, indie ecommerce operators, online course sellers, and small brands facing legitimate-looking chargebacks.
keyUX: Merchant selects a disputed order, connects payment, shipping, customer messages, refund history, and descriptor context; the app scores evidence gaps and produces a bank-ready response packet.
requiredUISections: Dispute-at-risk header with amount, deadline, reason code, and loss exposure
Order and payment descriptor comparison panel
Shipping, pickup, and delivery proof timeline
Customer conversation and refund-policy evidence lane
Friendly-fraud pattern detector using repeat buyer and address signals
Evidence gap checklist for issuer response rules
Representment packet preview with owner approval state
sourceSignals: S1 - ChargebackHelp, 2026 fraud trends show first-party fraud and automation raising the cost and complexity of chargeback management: https://chargebackhelp.com/what-2026-fraud-trends-mean-for-chargeback-management/

S2 - Authorize.net, 2026 guidance says friendly fraud, unclear descriptors, and missing evidence force merchants to collect fulfillment and conversation proof: https://www.authorize.net/resources/blog/2026/chargeback-fraud-versus-legitimate-disputes.html

S3 - Reddit r/smallbusiness, business owner describes fake invoices, frozen account, and weeks unable to use bank/software after ACH/card abuse: https://www.reddit.com/r/smallbusiness/comments/192mybf/someone_achd_14000_out_of_our_account_what_can_i/
stitchPrompt: Build a production-grade web app prototype called "Chargeback Friendly-Fraud Evidence Pack" for small ecommerce merchants fighting friendly-fraud disputes. The first screen must be a working chargeback evidence workspace with a dispute-at-risk header, order/payment descriptor comparison, shipping and delivery proof timeline, customer conversation lane, friendly-fraud pattern detector, evidence gap checklist, and bank-ready representment packet preview. Use realistic sample data: $276 skincare order, Visa reason code 10.4, 5-day response deadline, Shopify delivery confirmation, customer DM asking for a refund after receipt, same buyer with two prior disputes, and a confusing billing descriptor. Design direction: use the operator-dense profile with compact evidence rows, tabular deadline/money math, crisp risk badges, and one sharp action accent for the next required proof item. Do not make a marketing landing page; the first screen must be the working app.
